# odinex_server (Data Source)

Looks up a server by ID, name or label selector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_server" "web" {
  name = "web-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the server.
- `name` (String) Name of the server.
- `with_selector` (String) Label selector, e.g. `env=prod,role`.
- `with_status` (List of String) Only servers with one of these statuses.

### Read-Only

- `backup_window` (String) Backup window.
- `backups` (Boolean) Whether backups are enabled.
- `delete_protection` (Boolean) Whether delete protection is on.
- `elastic_ip_address` (String) Address of the Elastic IP (empty without one).
- `elastic_ip_id` (Number) ID of the Elastic IP of a server without public IPs.
- `floating_ips` (List of Number) IDs of assigned floating IPs.
- `image` (String) Name (or ID) of the image.
- `ipv4_address` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Public IPv6 address.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `location` (String) Location name.
- `network` (List of Object) Private networks (`network_id`, `ip`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network))
- `placement_group_id` (Number) Placement group ID.
- `primary_disk_size` (Number) Disk size in GB.
- `primary_network_id` (Number) Network a server without public IPs lives on.
- `rescue_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rescue system is enabled.
- `server_type` (String) Name of the server type.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `volumes` (List of Number) IDs of attached volumes.

<a id="nestedatt--network"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String)
- `network_id` (Number)
